description: Bedroom drawing updates grounded in captures of the existing Three.js model. The model itself was not changed.

images.prompt: Edit this CAD-style bedroom illustration to remove the exaggerated wide-angle/fisheye appearance. Render the SAME room using a natural architectural perspective like a 45–50 mm full-frame rectilinear lens, camera level at eye height, corrected verticals. Back the virtual camera away as needed, allowing a modestly tighter crop instead of stretching the room to fit everything. Walls, wardrobe uprights and window jambs must be straight and vertical, furniture at the edges must not loom or stretch; reduce the huge foreground-to-background scale difference. Keep the physical room proportions and existing furniture layout unchanged. Preserve EXACTLY ONE single wooden bed with white bedding, headboard against the same back wall, foot toward viewer, bed in the same location and orientation relative to wardrobe and window. Preserve the thin precise dark CAD linework, restrained shading, white walls, wood floor, same window bars and AC, same matching wooden frame and gently curved footboard. No new objects, no labels or dimensions. Single landscape image, believable room scale, no fisheye, no ultra-wide perspective. Wardrobe remains on LEFT, window and AC remain on RIGHT.
images.layoutGenerationPrompt: Create the updated CAD-style bedroom reference illustration using image 1 as the AUTHORITATIVE spatial layout and camera reference captured directly from the actual Three.js house model. Image 2 is ONLY the bed appearance and architectural illustration style reference. Match image 1's room geometry, camera viewpoint, bed location and longitudinal direction EXACTLY. Keep exactly one 1.90m by 0.90m single bed at the position shown in image 1; do not print dimensions. The pillow/headboard must touch the same blank end wall as in image 1; the foot projects toward the viewer and the long bed axis runs parallel to the wall containing the window, not under/across the window. Render the bed with the reddish-brown wooden frame and gently curved wooden footboard, white mattress, neat white duvet and one pillow from image 2, scaled to a single bed; no exposed slats or empty frame. Convert the low-poly screenshot to precise thin dark architectural outlines and muted soft material shading, off-white walls, natural wood-look floor. Keep open fitted wardrobe, window with exterior bars and split AC at their image 1 locations. Remove screenshot camera hotspot icons and harsh game-like shadows. Close the open screenshot roof with a plain white ceiling at the existing wall height; no invented architecture, furniture, text or dimensions. One landscape perspective image, schematic CAD illustration, not photorealism. REAR BEDROOM: image 1 places open wardrobe along LEFT wall, window and AC on RIGHT wall, bed centrally between them with headboard at far BACK blank wall. Preserve that exact arrangement and clear passages on both sides. Existing 3D bed center is x=4.15, depth=13.97, head toward depth=14.92. These coordinates are guidance only, never print them.
images.perspective: Natural rectilinear architectural perspective with corrected verticals and reduced wide-angle distortion.
